separate_factorial_anchor.design: greenhouse-induced early flowering x removal of Claytonia virginica flowers; plots as units; 5928 flowers across plots, not independent replicates
separate_factorial_anchor.interpretation: No detected interaction on overall seeds/flower. Do not infer equivalence. Greenhouse manipulation also alters conditions; competitor removal is external intervention, not independently measured endogenous recourse.

remaining_source_checks.result: Abstract reports 57% early deficit relative to supplemented S. graminifolia; compiled early relative deficit 56.916%. Abstract also reports no seed-set difference later, and no overall pollen limitation in S. juncea; no four-arm table or SD definitions recovered.
remaining_source_checks.remaining: Full tables and clone/ramet sampling covariance; two pairs remain provisional.

remaining_source_checks.result: Abstract reports pollen addition failed to raise late-season fruit set in each year; positive effect in peak 1985, not general late depletion. Interannual flowering intensity matters.
remaining_source_checks.remaining: JSTOR landing page no readable text; numerical tables and repeated plant design not recovered.

remaining_source_checks.result: Original abstract distinguishes blooming order within ramets, spatial position and year. V. myrtillus supplemented seed number declines and natural fruit set increases with season; other species lack detected timing effect. Not all endpoints share the same pattern.
remaining_source_checks.remaining: Publisher subscription preview; author repository/ResearchGate abstract only via current text access. Exact year and cell SD/SE semantics not verified.
